totalComments: 0 }) // Load followers count const { count: followers } = await supabase .from('followers') .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true }) .eq('following_id', user.id) setFollowersCount(followers || 0) // Load following count const { count: following } = await supabase .from('followers') .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true }) .eq('follower_id', user.id) setFollowingCount(following || 0) } catch (error) { console.error('Error loading profile data:', error) } finally { setLoading(false) } } const formatDate = (date) => { return new
